$comment: Authoring source for photo series (專題). Edit this by hand, then run `npm run build:gallery`. Photos whose filename matches a series' `match` regex are tagged with that series id in js/gallery-data.json and are shown on the series page instead of the home grid. `layout` controls the order and column span on the series page; `span` is "full" (whole row) or "half".

series.title: Japan · Tōhoku
series.summary: 五月的東北。先在山形的展望台上往下看城市的幾何，隔天南下福島，走過花見山公園的新綠，最後停在會津若松城的白牆前。兩天，五張。
